title: Unmeasured GPGPU Offloading
pattern: Offloading a computation or list iteration to a GPU kernel (via CUDA or OpenCL) without measuring the host-to-device memory transfer size.
why_bad: The PCIe bus memory copy latency between host RAM and GPU device memory is massive (~10–100 µs). If the dataset is small or the calculation is simple, this transfer cost completely overshadows any parallel calculation speedup, running much slower than standard CPU execution [12].
detection: Invocations of GPU kernels or GPGPU buffers for datasets with limited dimension sizes (e.g., < 100,000 array items) or trivial mathematical operations.
counterexample: Complex matrix multiplications of massive images or neural network training where data calculations represent billions of FLOPS. `Context-dependent`.
fix: Perform the calculation on the CPU using standard vectorization or parallel threads.
